card.name: Linking words just before "death"
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, or, of, a comma) or the word "clinical" right before the word "death" in warnings about severe outcomes. Often in capitalized boxed warnings.

modes.label: Link before death
modes.description: And, or, of or a comma ends a list of severe outcomes, and "death" comes next.
modes.example: POSSIBLY LEADING TO PERMANENT BRAIN DAMAGE<< OR>> DEATH (SEE OVERDOSAGE

modes.label: Clinical death
modes.description: The word "clinical" comes right before "death" in the flat EEG overdose passage.
modes.example: normally equated with<< clinical>> death cannot be accepted.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing "death" next and away from the word "dead".
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before "death" in a list of serious outcomes.
